    Applies Savitzky-Golay filter for initial smoothing, then implements adaptive
    hysteresis with multi-sample confirmation requirements. Only registers slope
    changes when derivative exceeds threshold for multiple consecutive samples.
    Post-processing smooths minor spurious reversals to further reduce slope_changes.
    
    Args:
        input_signal: Input time series data (1D array)
        window_size: Window size for processing (will be adjusted to odd number)
        algorithm_type: Type of algorithm (kept for compatibility)
    
    Returns:

        return input_signal.copy()

    window_length = window_size if window_size % 2 == 1 else window_size + 1

    # Set hysteresis threshold (2.5x noise standard deviation)
    hysteresis_threshold = 2.5 * noise_std

    confirmation_count = 0
    pending_direction = 0

                confirmation_count = 1

                pending_direction = -1
                confirmation_count = 1

                    confirmation_count = 0

    genuine trend changes. Uses local slope analysis to detect and smooth
